sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the numeric comparisons: sh:minInclusive is currently attached to properties whose values are QUDT QuantityValue nodes, so constrain qudt:numericValue inside each quantity node shape with the appropriate decimal minimum (1.5, 1.3, or 1.0). Also do not reuse one PropellerShaftComponentShape containing fatigueSafetyFactor across all three alternatives: that makes the fatigue factor mandatory for extreme-operational and blade-failure cases and creates accidental conjunctive requirements. Use a fatigue-specific component path shape for the fatigue branch, while retaining the existing cross-owner inverse hasPropellerShaftLineComponent / hasComponent path and applying the 1.5 minimum only there.
